verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS with client SDKs, an MCP server and an AI toolkit, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any setting or flag to disable telemetry or usage tracking. The pack covers only purchases, entitlements, charts, webhooks and AI tooling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
